FINDING_ID: IM_F003  
SEVERITY: 0.87  
FLAW_CLASS: 2  
ABSTRACTION_INDEX: 0.58  
DESCRIPTION: `process_round()` tells the health monitor a model “failed” only when the response is missing or unparsable. TIMEOUT, EMPTY, FORMAT, and UNDERPERFORM failures detected by `FailureHandler` are invisible to immune per-model failure tracking.  
PROPOSED_FIX: Drive the health monitor from the authoritative `failures` map, not from `parseable` alone.  
FIND: Location [dynamic_management.py](/Users/georgejackson/Developer_Projects/Constraint_Engineering/bench/dynamic_management.py#L5299), [dynamic_management.py](/Users/georgejackson/Developer_Projects/Constraint_Engineering/bench/dynamic_management.py#L5189), [dynamic_management.py](/Users/georgejackson/Developer_Projects/Constraint_Engineering/bench/dynamic_management.py#L4437). I reproduced this with a parseable response whose `response_time` exceeded the timeout threshold: `FailureHandler.detect_failure()` returned `FailureType.TIMEOUT`, but the `process_round()` failure expression evaluated `False`.  
FIX:
```python
<<<<
            failed = mid not in responses or not responses[mid].parseable
====
            failed = (mid not in responses) or (failures.get(mid) is not None)
>>>>
```
FOLLOW: This changes `record_model_round()` inputs, so `model_failure` diagnoses, failure persistence, and `add_to_pre_decompose` remediation will finally track the same failure definition the orchestrator already uses.

FINDING_ID: IM_F004  
SEVERITY: 0.84  
FLAW_CLASS: 5  
ABSTRACTION_INDEX: 0.63  
DESCRIPTION: The verifier assumes “higher is better” for `vocab_growth`, but the `vocab_saturation` remediation works by lowering the threshold, not by forcing the raw metric upward. A successful threshold change can therefore be marked as ineffective and escalated unnecessarily.  
PROPOSED_FIX: Verify `vocab_saturation` by checking whether the pathology still holds under the new threshold, not by comparing raw metric direction.  
FIND: Location [dynamic_management.py](/Users/georgejackson/Developer_Projects/Constraint_Engineering/bench/dynamic_management.py#L3194), [dynamic_management.py](/Users/georgejackson/Developer_Projects/Constraint_Engineering/bench/dynamic_management.py#L5747), [dynamic_management.py](/Users/georgejackson/Developer_Projects/Constraint_Engineering/bench/dynamic_management.py#L2906). I reproduced this with `vocab_growth` fixed at `0.03`: after lowering `tau_vocab_growth` from `0.04` to `0.02`, `_verify_remediation_outcomes()` still emitted `Remediation INEFFECTIVE ...` and advanced the chain.
